title: Figure 9: Insulin-delivery system controlled by an implantable glucose sensor (Medtronic)
description: Photograph of a person's torso wearing a belt-mounted insulin pump with tubing to an infusion site, overlaid with numbered callouts 1 "Glucose sensor," 2 and 3 "Insulin pump." The caption reads "Figure 9. Control of an Insulin-Delivery System by an Implantable Glucose Sensor (Medtronic Inc.)." It accompanies the section "MEMS Blood Glucose Sensors."
